project: Medical Entries Data Pipeline & Search API

features.name: Project Bootstrap
features.description: Establish the Python project skeleton: package directory, requirements.txt (runtime: fastapi, uvicorn, rapidfuzz, pydantic), requirements-dev.txt (pytest, ruff, mypy, httpx), and a runnable ./init.sh that installs deps and passes with an empty package. Goal: a fresh checkout passes ./init.sh with no manual steps.

features.name: Mock Data Set & Schema Definition
features.description: Create docs/DATA_SCHEMA.md defining the medical entry shape, and a synthetic data/mock_entries.json (~50+ entries) that intentionally includes transcription typos in location and doctor fields (e.g. 'Bukalest' for 'Bucharest', 'Dobert' for 'Robert') to exercise fuzzy search. Data must be clearly synthetic (no real PHI).

features.name: JSON Loader / Data Pipeline
features.description: Implement the loader module that reads the JSON dump from a configurable path, validates each entry against the schema (Pydantic model from DATA_SCHEMA), normalizes fields (strip, lowercase for indexing), and returns a typed collection. Include a module-loadable entrypoint and unit tests covering: happy path, malformed entry rejection, missing file, and empty file.

features.name: In-Memory Fuzzy Search Index
features.description: Build an in-memory search index over the loaded entries using rapidfuzz for typo-tolerant matching across doctor name and location fields. Support searching across multiple fields, returning ranked results by similarity score, with a configurable score threshold. Must rebuild quickly so a daily refresh is cheap. Unit tests must assert 'Bukalest' matches 'Bucharest' and 'Dobert' matches 'Robert'.

features.name: FastAPI Search & Read Endpoints
features.description: Expose a FastAPI app with: GET /health, GET /entries (paginated list), GET /entries/{id} (single entry), and GET /search?q=&field=&limit= (fuzzy search). The index is built once at startup and held in process memory so searches are sub-millisecond. Add request/response Pydantic schemas. Tests use FastAPI TestClient (httpx).

features.name: Atomic Daily Refresh
features.description: Add a scheduled loader that re-pulls the JSON dump once a day (configurable interval, default 24h) and atomically swaps the live index so concurrent searches never see a half-loaded state. Provide a way to trigger a manual reload (e.g. POST /admin/reload or a CLI command). Include a test that verifies a reload swaps the index atomically without serving partial data.

features.name: Configuration, Logging & Resilience
features.description: Add configuration via environment variables / .env (data path, refresh interval, host/port, log level) with sensible defaults. Structured logging around load, reload, and request errors. Make the service resilient: if the daily refresh fails, keep serving the last good index and log the error rather than crashing.

features.name: Containerization & Run Instructions
features.description: Add a Dockerfile (multi-stage, slim base) and a docker-compose for local run. Write README.md with: architecture summary, how to run ./init.sh, how to start the API, how to trigger a reload, and example curl queries showing fuzzy search. This is the low-maintenance deployment story.

features.name: Final Verification & Handoff
features.description: Run ./init.sh end-to-end, confirm all features are 'done', record evidence in verification_evidence.md, update progress.md and session-handoff.md, and ensure a fresh checkout runs cleanly. This is the closing gate before delivery.
